integrity: The proof uses exact Mayer–Vietoris maps over Z; the accompanying five finite GF(2) checks are illustrative and cannot verify absence of torsion.
scientific_limitations: Integral reduced homology only; no homotopy wedge claim, homology group action, or other matching threshold; both cycles length at least six. Independent validation has not been performed. Originality remains subject to unindexed or implicit prior results.
title: Two adjacent integral homology degrees in near-maximum matching avoidance on two cycles
